The open gripper advances over the grape bunch and descends until its jaws straddle the bunch.
The jaws close around the grape bunch and hold it low over the orange mat. Exact finger-to-stem contact is partly obscured by the gripper.
The grasped grapes move left toward the green plate with the gripper very low; some grapes or stems may continue contacting the mat during the transfer.
The bunch is positioned on the green plate and the jaws open to release it. The bunch spans the plate with its rightmost grapes near or slightly beyond the rim.
The empty gripper withdraws upward and rearward; the grapes remain on the plate.
The arm holds at the rear and the released grapes remain settled on the green plate through the last frame.

selected_segment.reason: The complete source contains one continuous grasp, transfer, and release of a single bunch of grapes, followed only by withdrawal and a stationary hold. Retain the entire single action.
selected_segment.terminal_state: The grapes remain on the green plate and the gripper is empty and withdrawn above the rear edge of the mat.
